summary: 提高自尊能否带来好成绩和好行为？作者检查测量方法与因果证据，发现自我感觉良好和实际表现之间的联系远比想象中有限。
logic: 提升自尊为何成为公共议题
自我报告给测量带来哪些偏差
核对学业、工作与人际表现
考察性行为、饮酒与用药的证据
霸凌与幸福感分别和自尊有何关系
辨清因果，再评估提升自尊的做法

paragraphs.brief: 从个人自尊到社会运动
sentences: People intuitively recognize the importance of self-esteem to their psychological health, so it isn’t particularly remarkable that most of us try to protect and enhance it in ourselves whenever possible.
人们直觉上都明白自尊对于心理健康的重要性，因此我们尽可能维护和增强自己的自尊，也就不足为奇。

What is remarkable is that attention to self-esteem has become a communal concern, at least for Americans, who see a favorable opinion of oneself as the central psychological source from which all manner of positive outcomes spring.
值得注意的是，至少在美国，自尊已经成了整个社会关心的问题，人们往往把肯定自己看作种种积极结果的心理根源。
The corollary, that low self-esteem lies at the root of individual and thus societal problems, has sustained an ambitious social agenda for decades.
由此推论，低自尊是个人问题乃至社会问题的根源；这一信念几十年来一直支撑着雄心勃勃的社会改革议程。
Indeed, campaigns to raise people’s sense of self-worth abound.
事实上，旨在提高人们自我价值感的运动比比皆是。
paragraphs.gist: 在美国，提高自尊从个人愿望演变成社会运动，其背后是一种信念，即积极结果源自高自尊，许多个人和社会问题则根源于低自尊。

paragraphs.brief: 加州工作组的主张与证据
sentences: Consider what transpired in California in the late 1980s.
不妨看看20世纪80年代末加利福尼亚州发生的事。
Prodded by State Assemblyman John Vasconcellos, Governor George Deukmejian set up a task force on self-esteem and personal and social responsibility.
在州议员约翰·瓦斯孔塞洛斯的推动下，州长乔治·德克梅吉安成立了自尊与个人及社会责任工作组。

Vasconcellos argued that raising self-esteem in young people would reduce crime, teen pregnancy, drug abuse, school underachievement and pollution, and even help to balance the state budget, a prospect predicated on the observation that people with high self-regard earn more than others and thus pay more in taxes.
瓦斯孔塞洛斯认为，提高年轻人的自尊可以减少犯罪、青少年怀孕、药物滥用、学业不佳及污染，甚至有助于平衡州预算，因为自我评价高的人收入较高，纳税也较多。
Along with its other activities, the task force assembled a team of scholars to survey the relevant literature.
除了其他活动外，工作队还召集了一个学者小组调查有关文献。

The results appeared in The Social Importance of Self-Esteem (University of California Press, 1989), which stated that many, if not most, of the major problems plaguing society have roots in the low self-esteem of many of the people who make up society.
工作组的结论发表于1989年加州大学出版社出版的《自尊的社会意义》，书中称，许多困扰社会的重大问题都源于不少社会成员自尊偏低。
In reality, the report contained little to support that assertion.
实际上，报告没有多少内容支持这一说法。
The California task force disbanded in 1995, but a nonprofit organization called the National Association for Self-Esteem (NASE) has picked up its mantle.
加州工作组于1995年解散，但非营利机构美国全国自尊协会（NASE）继承了它的工作。
Vasconcellos, until recently a California state senator, is on the advisory board.
瓦斯孔塞洛斯直到不久前还担任加州参议员，也是该协会的顾问委员会成员。
paragraphs.gist: 加州曾成立工作组，希望提高自尊能减少犯罪等社会问题，甚至增加税收，然而其文献报告并未为这些主张提供多少证据。

paragraphs.brief: 重新检验提高自尊的依据
sentences: Was it reasonable for leaders in California to start fashioning therapies and social policies without supportive data?
加州领导人在没有支持性数据的情况下开始制定治疗和社会政策是否合理？
Perhaps, given that they had problems to address.
也许，鉴于他们有问题要解决。
But one can draw on many more studies now than was the case 15 years ago, enough to assess the value of self-esteem in several spheres.
如今可供参考的研究远多于15年前，已经足以评估自尊在几个领域的价值。

Regrettably, those who have been pursuing self-esteem-boosting programs, including the leaders of NASE, have not shown a desire to examine the new work, which is why the four of us recently came together under the aegis of the American Psychological Society to review the scientific literature.
令人遗憾的是，包括全国自尊协会负责人在内的项目倡导者并未表现出检视新研究的意愿，因此我们四人在美国心理科学学会支持下共同回顾了相关科学文献。
paragraphs.gist: 如今可用研究已远多于15年前，四名作者遂在美国心理科学学会支持下审查文献，重新检验提高自尊的政策依据。

paragraphs.brief: 自尊测量中的自报偏差
sentences: Gauging the value of self-esteem requires, first of all, a sensible way to measure it.
衡量自尊的价值首先需要明智的衡量方法。
Most investigators just ask people what they think of themselves.
大多数研究者只是询问受试者如何看待自己。
Naturally enough, the answers are often colored by the common tendency to want to make oneself look good.
人们通常希望给别人留下好印象，回答自然常常受到这种倾向的影响。
Unfortunately, psychologists lack good methods to judge self-esteem.
不幸的是，心理学家缺乏判断自尊的好方法。
sectionTitle: In the Eye of the Beholder
paragraphs.gist: 研究者多靠当事人自述来衡量自尊，但人往往想展现较好的一面，心理学家又缺乏可靠的替代测量办法。

paragraphs.brief: 自评外貌的两种解释
sentences: Consider, for instance, research on the relation between self-esteem and physical attractiveness.
例如，考虑研究自尊与身体吸引力之间的关系。
Several studies have generally found clear positive links when people rate themselves on both properties.
好几项研究发现，让人同时给自己的自尊和外貌吸引力打分时，两项分数通常有明显的正相关。

It seems plausible that physically attractive people would end up with high self-esteem because they are treated more favorably than unattractive ones–being more popular, more sought after, more valued by lovers and friends, and so forth.
外貌出众的人比相貌平平的人更受优待，往往更受欢迎、更受追捧，也更受伴侣和朋友珍视。因此，他们最终拥有较高自尊似乎合乎情理。
But it could just as well be that those who score highly on self-esteem scales by claiming to be wonderful people all around also boast of being physically attractive.
不过，另一种解释同样说得通：自称各方面都很优秀、因而在自尊量表上得分很高的人，也会夸赞自己的外貌。
paragraphs.gist: 自评外貌与自评自尊呈正相关，既可能因为好看的人受到优待，也可能是自视甚高的人同时夸大了自己的吸引力。

paragraphs.brief: 他评外貌检验自尊关联
sentences: In 1995 Edward F. Diener and Brian Wolsic of the University of Illinois and Frank Fujita of Indiana University South Bend examined this possibility.
1995年，伊利诺伊大学的Edward F. Diener和Brian Wolsic和印第安纳大学南本德的Frank Fujita研究了这种可能性。
They obtained self-esteem scores from a broad sample of the population and then photographed everybody, presenting these pictures to a panel of judges, who evaluated the subjects for attractiveness.
他们测量来自广泛群体的受试者的自尊，再拍下每个人的照片，交给独立评委评价其外貌吸引力。
Ratings based on full-length photographs showed no significant correlation with self-esteem.
根据全身照作出的评价与自尊没有显著关联。
When the judges were shown pictures of just the participants’ unadorned faces, the correlation between attractiveness and self-esteem was once again zero.
当评委只看参与者未加修饰的面部照片时，外貌吸引力与自尊的相关性仍为零。
In that same investigation, however, self-reported physical attractiveness was found to have a strong correlation with self-esteem.
然而，在同一调查中，自报的身体吸引力与自尊密切相关。
Clearly, those with high self-esteem are gorgeous in their own eyes but not necessarily to others.
可见高自尊者在自己眼中很有魅力，但别人并不一定也这么看。
paragraphs.gist: 同一批人自评的外貌与自尊密切相关，可让独立评委看全身照或素颜脸部照片时，都未发现显著关联。

paragraphs.brief: 普遍消极的评价倾向
sentences: This discrepancy should be sobering.
这种差异应当令人清醒。
What seemed at first to be a strong link between physical good looks and high self-esteem turned out to be nothing more than a pattern of consistency in how favorably people rate themselves.
最初看来是身体美貌和高度自尊之间的紧密联系，但实际上只不过是人们如何自我评价的一贯性。

A parallel phenomenon affects those with low self-esteem, who are prone to floccinaucinihilipilification, a highfalutin word (among the longest in the Oxford English Dictionary) but one that we can’t resist using here, it being defined as the action or habit of estimating as worthless.
低自尊者身上也有类似现象：他们容易把事物一概看作毫无价值。作者忍不住用了《牛津英语词典》里最长的词之一 floccinaucinihilipilification，指的正是这种举动或习惯。
That is, people with low self-esteem are not merely down on themselves; they are negative about everything.
换句话说，低自尊者不只对自己评价低，对其他事物也往往抱持消极态度。
paragraphs.gist: 自尊和外貌之间看似牢固的联系可以来自一贯的自评倾向，低自尊者尤易把自己和周围事物都看得毫无价值。

paragraphs.brief: 衡量偏见的方法改变结论
sentences: This tendency has certainly distorted some assessments.
这种趋势无疑扭曲了一些评估。
For example, psychologists once thought that people with low self-esteem were especially prejudiced.
例如，心理学家曾经认为，自尊心低的人特别有偏见。
But thoughtful scholars, such as Jennifer Crocker of the University of Michigan at Ann Arbor, questioned this conclusion.
但深思熟虑的学者，如安阿伯密歇根大学的詹妮弗·克罗克，对这一结论提出质疑。
After all, if people rate themselves negatively, it is hard to label them as prejudiced for rating people not like themselves similarly.
若一个人对自己评价消极，也以同样消极的态度评价与自己不同的人，很难就此断定此人抱有偏见。

When one uses the difference between the subjects’ assessments of their own group and their ratings of other groups as the yardstick for bias, the findings are reversed: people with high self-esteem appear to be more prejudiced.
若以受试者对本群体和其他群体的评分差来衡量偏见，结论正好倒转：高自尊者似乎更容易抱有偏见。

Floccinaucinihilipilification also raises the danger that those who describe themselves disparagingly may describe their lives similarly, thus furnishing the appearance that low self-esteem has unpleasant outcomes.
习惯于贬低事物还会带来另一种误判：贬低自己的人也可能低估自己的生活，使低自尊看上去像是带来了不良后果。
paragraphs.gist: 如果用对本群体和其他群体的评分差来衡量偏见，结果反而显示高自尊者偏见更强，说明普遍负面的打分会误导解释。

paragraphs.brief: 筛选客观证据与区分因果
sentences: Given the often misleading nature of self-reports, we set up our review to emphasize objective measures wherever possible–a requirement that greatly reduced the number of relevant studies (from more than 15,000 to about 200).
考虑到自报结果常会误导，我们尽量优先采用客观指标；仅这一要求就使可纳入的研究从一万五千多项减至约两百项。
We were also mindful to avoid another fallacy: the assumption that a correlation between self-esteem and some desired behavior establishes causality.
我们还刻意避免另一种谬误，即把自尊与某种理想行为的相关性当作因果关系的证明。
Indeed, the question of causality goes to the heart of the debate.
事实上，因果关系问题涉及到辩论的核心。
If high self-esteem brings about certain positive outcomes, it may well be worth the effort and expense of trying to instill this feeling.
如果高度的自尊带来某些积极的结果，那么，努力灌输这种感觉很可能值得付出努力和代价。
But if the correlations mean simply that a positive self-image is a result of success or good behavior–which is certainly plausible– there is little to be gained by raising self-esteem alone.
但是，如果这种关联仅仅意味着正面的自我形象是成功或良好行为的结果 — — 这当然是有道理的 — — 单靠提高自尊是没有什么好处的。
We began our two-year effort by reviewing studies relating self-esteem to academic performance.
我们开始两年的努力，审查了与学术成绩有关的自尊研究。
paragraphs.gist: 作者优先采用客观指标，把逾万项研究筛至约两百项，并特别区分成功提升自尊与自尊促成成功两种因果方向。

paragraphs.brief: 自尊能否改善学校表现
sentences: At the outset, we had every reason to hope that boosting self-esteem would be a potent tool for helping students.
首先，我们完全有理由希望，提高自尊心将成为帮助学生的有力工具。

Logic suggests that having a good dollop of self-esteem would enhance striving and persistence in school, while making a student less likely to succumb to paralyzing feelings of incompetence or self-doubt.
直觉上，较高自尊会促使学生在学习中努力并坚持，也使他们较不易因无能感或自我怀疑而裹足不前。
Modern studies have, however, cast doubt on the idea that higher self-esteem actually induces students to do better.
然而，现代研究使人们怀疑，提高自尊实际上会促使学生做得更好。
paragraphs.gist: 人们有理由期待自尊能让学生坚持努力、减少自我怀疑，但新的研究对提高自尊能否改善成绩提出质疑。

paragraphs.brief: 跨年级追踪自尊与成绩
sentences: Such inferences about causality are possible when the subjects are examined at two different times, as was the case in 1986 when Sheila M. Pottebaum and her colleagues at the University of Iowa tested more than 23,000 high school students, first in the 10th and again in the 12th grade.
在两个不同时间点考察同一批受试者，就可能对因果关系作出这样的推断。1986 年，爱荷华大学的希拉·M. 波特鲍姆及其同事就对超过 2.3 万名高中生进行了两轮测试，首次在十年级，第二次在十二年级。
They found that self-esteem in 10th grade is only weakly predictive of academic achievement in 12th grade.
他们发现十年级的自尊只能对十二年级的学业成绩作出微弱预测
Academic achievement in 10th grade correlates with self-esteem in 12th grade only trivially better.
十年级成绩对十二年级自尊的关联强度也仅略高一点。
Such results, which are now available from multiple studies, certainly do not indicate that raising self-esteem offers students much benefit.
这些成果现在可以从多种研究中获得，但肯定不能说明提高自尊对学生大有裨益。
Some findings even suggest that artificially boosting self-esteem may lower subsequent performance.
一些结果甚至提示，人为抬高自尊可能降低后续学业表现。
paragraphs.gist: 对两万多名学生的跨年级追踪发现，自尊对后续成绩的预测很弱，有些研究甚至提示刻意提高自尊可能损害表现。

paragraphs.brief: 工作表现与自尊相关较弱
sentences: Even if raising self-esteem does not foster academic progress, might it serve some purpose later, say, on the job?
即便提高自尊心不会促进学术进步，但后来，比如说，在工作上，它能否起到某种作用？
Apparently not.
看来也没有。

Studies of possible links between workers’ self-regard and job performance echo what has been found with schoolwork: the simple search for correlations yields some suggestive results, but these do not show whether a good self-image leads to occupational success, or vice versa.
自我评价与工作表现的研究和学业研究相似：可以看出一些相关性，却说不清究竟是良好的自我评价促成职业成功，还是职业成功提升了自我评价。
In any case, the link is not particularly strong.
无论如何，这种联系并不特别牢固。
paragraphs.gist: 工作表现与自我评价的关联同样较弱，现有相关性数据也无法判定是自信带来事业成功，还是成功提升了自信。

paragraphs.brief: 自信是否有助赢得好感
sentences: The failure to contribute significantly at school or at the office would be easily offset if a heightened sense of self-worth helped someone to get along better with others.
即使自尊对学业或工作表现帮助不大，若能让人更好地与他人相处，这项不足也很容易得到弥补。

Having a good self-image might make someone more likable insofar as people prefer to associate with confident, positive individuals and generally avoid those who suffer from self-doubts and insecurities.
拥有良好的自我形象可能会使人们更讨人喜欢，因为人们宁愿与自信、积极的个人联系在一起，而且通常避免那些遭受自我怀疑和不安全之苦的人。
paragraphs.gist: 即使提高自尊对学业和工作帮助有限，如果自信乐观的人更讨人喜欢，它仍可能通过改善人际关系体现价值。

paragraphs.brief: 同伴互评检验受欢迎程度
sentences: People who regard themselves highly generally state that they are popular and rate their friendships as being of superior quality to those described by people with low self-esteem, who report more negative interactions and less social support.
自我评价高的人常自称受欢迎，认为友谊质量更好；自尊较低的人则表示负面互动较多、得到的社会支持较少。
But as Julia Bishop and Heidi M. Inderbitzen-Nolan of the University of Nebraska-Lincoln showed in 1995, these assertions do not reflect reality.
但是，正如内布拉斯加-林肯大学的Julia Bishop和Heidi M. Inderbitzen-Noran1995年所显示的那样，这些说法并不反映现实。
The investigators asked 542 ninth-grade students to nominate their most-liked and least-liked peers, and the resulting rankings displayed no correlation whatsoever with self-esteem scores.
调查人员要求542名九年级学生提名他们最受欢迎和最不受欢迎的同龄人，由此产生的排名与自尊得分没有任何关联。
paragraphs.gist: 高自尊青少年自称友谊更好，但542名九年级学生互相提名喜欢与不喜欢的同伴时，所得排名与自尊分数无关。

paragraphs.brief: 由室友评价五类社交能力
sentences: A few other sound studies have found that the same is true for adults.
其他几项可靠研究发现，成年人身上也出现了同样的情况。

In one of these investigations, conducted in the late 1980s, Duane P. Buhrmester, now at the University of Texas at Dallas, reported that college students with high levels of self-regard claimed to be substantially better at initiating relationships, disclosing things about themselves, asserting themselves in response to objectionable behaviors by others, providing emotional support and even managing interpersonal conflicts.
比尔梅斯特在20世纪80年代末的一项研究中发现，自尊高的大学生自评在结交朋友、向人敞开心扉、应对不当行为、提供情感支持和解决人际冲突五方面都强得多。
Their roommates’ ratings, however, told a different story.
但他们室友给出的评价讲述了另一种情况。
For four of the five interpersonal skills surveyed, the correlation with self-esteem dropped to near zero.
在所调查的5种人际交往技能中，有4种与自尊的相互关系下降到接近零。
The only one that remained statistically significant was with the subjects’ ability to initiate new social contacts and friendships.
只有主动建立新社交联系和友谊的能力，仍与自尊显著相关。

This does seem to be one sphere in which confidence indeed matters: people who think that they are desirable and attractive should be adept at striking up conversations with strangers, whereas those with low self-esteem presumably shy away, fearing rejection.
建立新关系看来确实需要自信：觉得自己讨人喜欢的人容易和陌生人攀谈，自尊低的人则可能因害怕被拒绝而退缩。
paragraphs.gist: 大学生自评多项社交技能时显得颇为自信，可室友的评分显示，五项之中只有主动结交新朋友与自尊显著相关。

paragraphs.brief: 自尊与伴侣关系的稳定性
sentences: One can imagine that such differences might influence a person’s love life, too.
人们可以想象，这种差异也会影响一个人的爱情生活。

In 2002 Sandra L. Murray of the University at Buffalo found that people low in self-esteem tend to distrust their partners’ expressions of love and support, acting as though they are constantly expecting rejection.
2002年，布法罗大学的Sandra L. Murray发现，自尊心低落的人往往不信任其伴侣表达的爱和支持，似乎他们一直期待遭到拒绝。
Thus far, however, investigators have not produced evidence that such relationships are especially prone to dissolve.
然而，迄今为止，调查人员没有提供证据表明这种关系特别容易解体。

In fact, high self-esteem may be the bigger threat: as Caryl E. Rusbult of the University of Kentucky showed back in 1987, those who think highly of themselves are more likely than others to respond to problems by severing relations and seeking other partners.
事实上，高自尊对关系的威胁可能更大。肯塔基大学的研究者1987年发现，自我评价高的人碰到感情问题时，比其他人更倾向于结束关系、另找伴侣。
paragraphs.gist: 低自尊者虽容易怀疑伴侣的爱，却没有证据表明他们更容易分手，另有研究反而发现高自尊者遇事更愿结束关系。

paragraphs.brief: 自尊与青少年性行为
sentences: How about teenagers?
青少年怎么样？
How does self-esteem, or the lack thereof, influence their love life, in particular their sexual activity?
自尊高低对青少年的恋爱生活、尤其是性行为有什么影响？
Investigators have examined this subject extensively.
调查人员已广泛审查了这一问题。
All in all, the results do not support the idea that low self-esteem predisposes young people to more or earlier sexual activity.
总体来看，结果不支持自尊低的年轻人会更早或更频繁地发生性行为。
If anything, those with high self-esteem are less inhibited, more willing to disregard risks and more prone to engage in sex.
如果说有什么差异，倒是高自尊者顾虑较少、更愿忽略风险，也更可能发生性行为。
At the same time, bad sexual experiences and unwanted pregnancies appear to lower self-esteem.
同时，性经历不良和意外怀孕似乎降低了自尊。
paragraphs.gist: 现有结果不支持低自尊会导致青少年更早或更频繁地发生性行为，而不愉快的性经历和意外怀孕倒可能降低自尊。

paragraphs.brief: 饮酒与用药研究的混合结果
sentences: If not sex, then how about alcohol or illicit drugs?
如果不是性，那酒精或非法毒品呢？
Abuse of these substances is one of the most worrisome behaviors among young people, and many psychologists once believed that boosting self-esteem would prevent such problems.
滥用这些药物是年轻人最令人担忧的行为之一，许多心理学家曾经认为，提高自尊心可以防止出现这类问题。
The thought was that people with low self-esteem turn to drinking or drugs for solace.
其背后的想法是，自尊低的人会借酒或毒品寻求安慰。
The data, however, do not consistently show that low adolescent self-esteem causes or even correlates with the abuse of alcohol or other drugs.
然而，现有数据并不能一致地证明青少年自尊低会导致、甚至会伴随酗酒或其他药物滥用。

In particular, in a large-scale study in 2000, Rob McGee and Sheila M. Williams of the Dunedin School of Medicine at the University of Otago in New Zealand found no correlation between self-esteem measured between ages nine and 13 and drinking or drug use at age 15.
特别是，在2000年的一项大规模研究中，新西兰奥塔戈大学Dunedin医学院的Rob McGee和Sheila M. Williams发现，9至13岁的自尊与15岁喝酒或吸毒之间没有关联。
Even when findings do show links between alcohol use and self-esteem, they are mixed and inconclusive.
即使有的研究发现饮酒与自尊有关，它们的结果也不一致，无法定论。
We did find, however, some evidence that low self-esteem contributes to illicit drug use.
然而，我们确实发现一些证据表明，自尊心低下助长了非法药物的使用。

In particular, Judy A. Andrews and Susan C. Duncan of the Oregon Research Institute found in 1997 that declining levels of academic motivation (the main focus of their study) caused self-esteem to drop, which in turn led to marijuana use, although the connection was weak.
特别是俄勒冈研究所的Judy A. Andrews和Susan C. Duncan在1997年发现，学术动机的下降(其研究的主要重点)导致自尊心下降，这反过来又导致大麻的使用，尽管联系薄弱。
paragraphs.gist: 青少年自尊与饮酒或吸毒之间的研究结论并不一致，仅有部分证据表明自尊下降与后来使用大麻存在较弱联系。

paragraphs.brief: 不同动机干扰物质使用研究
sentences: Interpretation of the findings on drinking and drug abuse is probably complicated by the fact that some people approach the experience out of curiosity or thrill seeking, whereas others may use it to cope with or escape from chronic unhappiness.
有些人出于好奇或寻求刺激而饮酒、吸毒，另一些人则借此应对或逃避长期不快乐，这使研究结果更难解释。
The overall result is that no categorical statements can be made.
总体上无法得出一概而论的结论。
The same is true for tobacco use, where our study-by-study review uncovered a preponderance of results that show no influence.
吸烟也一样，逐项回顾研究后发现，多数结果都没有显示自尊会产生影响。
The few positive findings we unearthed could conceivably reflect nothing more than self-report bias.
我们发现的少数积极结论，可以想象，只能反映自我报告方面的偏见。
paragraphs.gist: 好奇、寻求刺激和逃避痛苦都可能驱使人饮酒或吸毒，难作一概而论的判断，关于吸烟的多数研究也未发现自尊的影响。

paragraphs.brief: 高自尊人群内部的差异
sentences: Another complication that also clouds these studies is that the category of people with high self-esteem contains individuals whose self-opinions differ in important ways.
这类研究还面临一个难题：“高自尊者”这个类别把自我看法在重要方面不同的人归在了一起。
Yet in most analyses, people with a healthy sense of self-respect are, for example, lumped with those feigning higher self-esteem than they really feel or who are narcissistic.
例如，大多数分析把有健康自尊的人、装作比实际更自信的人和自恋者归为一类。
Not surprisingly, the results of such investigations may produce weak or contradictory findings.
不足为奇的是，这种调查的结果可能会产生薄弱或相互矛盾的结果。
paragraphs.gist: 把真正自重者、假装自信者和自恋者归入同一个高自尊群体，会掩盖重要区别，可能造成薄弱或相互矛盾的研究结果。

paragraphs.brief: 攻击者也可能自我评价过高
sentences: For decades, psychologists believed that low self-esteem was an important cause of aggression.
几十年来，心理学家都认为低自尊是攻击行为的一个重要原因。

One of us (Baumeister) challenged that notion in 1996, when he reviewed assorted studies and concluded that perpetrators of aggression generally hold favorable and perhaps even inflated views of themselves.
作者之一鲍迈斯特在1996年回顾了多项研究后质疑这一说法，认为实施攻击的人通常相当看好自己，甚至可能自视过高。
paragraphs.gist: 针对低自尊会导致攻击行为的旧看法，鲍迈斯特的文献回顾指出，施暴者往往对自己评价良好，有时甚至过高。

paragraphs.brief: 儿童欺凌者的自信与焦虑
sentences: Take the bullying that goes on among children, a common form of aggression.
以儿童间的欺凌为例，这是常见的攻击形式。
Dan Olweus of the University of Bergen was one of the first to dispute the notion that under their tough exteriors, bullies suffer from insecurities and self-doubts.
卑尔根大学的丹·奥尔维乌斯较早质疑了这样一种看法：欺凌者强硬的外表下隐藏着不安全感与自我怀疑。
Although Olweus did not measure self-esteem directly, he showed that bullies reported less anxiety and were more sure of themselves than other children.
虽然奥尔韦斯没有直接衡量自尊，但他表明，欺凌者报告焦虑程度较低，比其他儿童更自信。
Apparently the same applies to violent adults.
显然，这同样适用于暴力的成年人。
paragraphs.gist: 儿童欺凌研究发现，欺凌者比其他孩子自报焦虑更少、对自己更有信心，这给“强硬外表掩饰不安”的解释提出了挑战。

paragraphs.brief: 幸福感研究出现稳定关联
sentences: After coming to the conclusion that high self-esteem does not lessen a tendency toward violence, that it does not deter adolescents from turning to alcohol, tobacco, drugs and sex, and that it fails to improve academic or job performance, we got a boost when we looked into how self-esteem relates to happiness.
我们先前发现，高自尊未能减弱暴力倾向、阻止青少年饮酒吸烟吸毒或发生性行为，也未改善学业和工作表现；转向研究它与幸福感的关系时，结果才令人振奋。
The consistent finding is that people with high self-esteem are significantly happier than others.
一贯的调查结果是，自尊心高的人比其他人幸福得多。
They are also less likely to be depressed.
他们也不太可能感到沮丧。
paragraphs.gist: 作者在行为与表现上少见高自尊的稳定好处，却发现它与更高的幸福感及更低的抑郁风险始终存在联系。

paragraphs.brief: 不同年龄人群的满意度调查
sentences: One especially compelling study was published in 1995, after Diener and his daughter Marissa, now a psychologist at the University of Utah, surveyed more than 13,000 college students, and high self-esteem emerged as the strongest factor in overall life satisfaction.
1995年发表的一项研究尤其引人注意。迪纳与女儿玛丽莎（现为犹他大学心理学家）调查了1.3万多名大学生，发现自尊与总体生活满意度的关系最强。
In 2004 Sonja Lyubomirsky, Christopher Tkach and M. Robin DiMatteo of the University of California, Riverside, reported data from more than 600 adults ranging in age from 51 to 95.
2004年，加州大学河滨分校的索尼娅·柳博米尔斯基、克里斯托弗·特卡奇和M.罗宾·迪马泰奥发表了对六百多名51至95岁成年人的调查结果。
Once again, happiness and self-esteem proved to be closely tied.
幸福和自尊再次证明是紧密相连的。
Before it is safe to conclude that high self-esteem leads to happiness, however, further research must address the shortcomings of the work that has been done so far.
然而，在得出高度的自尊导致幸福的结论之前，进一步研究必须解决迄今所开展工作的缺点。
paragraphs.gist: 大学生与中老年人的大型调查都发现自尊与生活满意度密切相关，但研究方法仍不足以证实高自尊使人更快乐。

paragraphs.brief: 幸福与自尊的因果方向
sentences: First, causation needs to be established.
第一，需要确定因果关系。
It seems possible that high self-esteem brings about happiness, but no research has shown this outcome.
高自尊有可能使人更幸福，但尚无研究证明这种因果方向。
The strong correlation between self-esteem and happiness is just that–a correlation.
自尊与幸福虽密切相关，目前能确定的也仅是相关关系。
It is plausible that occupational, academic or interpersonal successes cause both happiness and high self-esteem and that corresponding failures cause both unhappiness and low self-esteem.
一种合理的解释是，事业、学业或人际关系上的成功同时带来幸福感和高自尊，而这些方面的失败则同时降低幸福感和自尊。
It is even possible that happiness, in the sense of a temperament or disposition to feel good, induces high self-esteem.
还有一种可能：如果幸福表现为天生容易感到愉快的性情，那么促成高自尊的也许恰恰是这种幸福感。
paragraphs.gist: 自尊与幸福的相关性不足以确定因果，两者可能都源于成功经历，也可能是天性乐观的人更容易拥有高自尊。

paragraphs.brief: 幸福感测量的自报难题
sentences: Second, it must be recognized that happiness (and its opposite, depression) has been studied mainly by means of self-report, and the tendency of some people toward negativity may produce both their low opinions of themselves and unfavorable evaluations of other aspects of life.
第二，关于幸福及其反面抑郁的研究主要依赖自我报告。某些人的消极倾向，可能使他们既低估自己，也对生活的其他方面作出负面评价。
Yet it is not clear what could replace such assessments.
然而，尚不清楚什么可以取代这种评估。
An investigator would indeed be hard-pressed to demonstrate convincingly that a person was less (or more) happy than he or she supposed.
要令人信服地证明一个人的幸福程度低于或高于其自我感受，研究者确实很难做到。
Clearly, objective measures of happiness and depression are going to be difficult if not impossible to obtain, but that does not mean self-reports should be accepted uncritically.
显然，要客观衡量幸福和抑郁，即使不是不可能，也是困难的，但这并不意味着应该不加批判地接受自我报告。
paragraphs.gist: 幸福和抑郁主要靠自我报告来衡量，负面倾向会同时拉低多种评价，而客观指标难找也不意味着可以照单全收。

paragraphs.brief: 哪些自尊益处有证据
sentences: What then should we do?
那我们怎么办？
Should parents, teachers and therapists seek to boost self-esteem wherever possible?
父母、教师和治疗师应否尽可能提高自尊心？
In the course of our literature review, we found some indications that self-esteem is a helpful attribute.
在我们的文献审查过程中，我们发现一些迹象表明，自尊是一种有益的属性。
It improves persistence in the face of failure.
自尊能让人在面对失败时更愿意坚持。
And individuals with high self-esteem sometimes perform better in groups than do those with low self-esteem.
自尊心高的人有时在群体中表现优于自尊心低的人。
Also, a poor self-image is a risk factor for certain eating disorders, especially bulimia–a connection one of us (Vohs) and her colleagues documented in 1999.
此外，消极的自我形象是某些进食障碍、尤其是神经性贪食症的风险因素。本文作者之一沃斯及其同事在1999年记录了这种联系。
Other effects are harder to demonstrate with objective evidence, although we are inclined to accept the subjective evidence that self-esteem goes hand in hand with happiness.
要用客观证据证实其他效果则较难，不过，我们愿意接受自我报告所提示的自尊与幸福感往往相伴的关系。
paragraphs.gist: 较有依据的好处包括失败后更能坚持、有时在群体中表现更佳，较差的自我形象还与某些饮食失调风险有关。

paragraphs.brief: 普遍提升自尊的社会代价
sentences: So we can certainly understand how an injection of self-esteem might be valuable to the individual.
因此，我们确实能理解，适度增强自尊对一个人可能有价值。
But imagine if a heightened sense of self-worth prompted some people to demand preferential treatment or to exploit their fellows.
不过，不妨设想一下：如果增强的自我价值感让一些人要求特殊待遇，甚至利用同伴，后果会怎样？
Such tendencies would entail considerable social costs.
这种倾向将带来巨大的社会代价。

And we have found little to indicate that indiscriminately promoting self-esteem in today’s children or adults, just for being themselves, offers society any compensatory benefits beyond the seductive pleasure it brings to those engaged in the exercise.
我们几乎找不到证据表明，仅仅因为孩子或成人“做了自己”就一律提高其自尊，除了让参与者觉得很愉快，还能给社会带来足以抵消这些代价的好处。
paragraphs.gist: 自尊可能对个人有益，但若使人索求特权或利用他人，社会须付出代价，目前几乎没有证据表明无差别提高自尊能弥补这些代价。

points: 提高自尊能否带来好成绩和好行为？作者检查测量方法与因果证据，发现自我感觉良好和实际表现之间的联系远比想象中有限。
自尊热与测量偏差 → 学业和人际表现 → 冒险、攻击与幸福感 → 检验因果再谈干预
clauses: Regrettably, those …, have not shown a desire to examine the new work, which is why the four of us recently came together under the aegis of the American Psychological Society to review the scientific literature.
“who have been pursuing self-esteem-boosting programs, including the leaders of NASE”修饰前面的 those。先认出先行词，再读从句补充的特征。
读到 who 时，回看 those，再把修饰信息接回主句。
“that people with low self-esteem were especially prejudiced”补足 thought 的内容，交代究竟在说、判断或发现什么。
先读 thought 所在的主句，再把 that 后面的内容作为一个整体。
lead: Boosting people’s sense of self-worth has become a national preoccupation.
如何提升人们的自我价值感，已成为全国上下热衷讨论的事。
Yet surprisingly, research shows that such efforts do little to improve academic performance or prevent troublesome behavior.
然而，研究得出了一个令人意外的结果：这些努力在提高学业成绩或预防问题行为方面几乎不起作用。
